project.name: ERP Foundation - Kernel
project.description:
P1-01 - Common Kernel (Docs/Plan/base01.md). Deliberately tiny: only concepts that genuinely have the same meaning everywhere.
id strongly typed identifiers time clock / instants result success-or-failure carrier error error taxonomy lifecycle enable/disable/archive style state value shared immutable value semantics
Pure Java. Zero runtime dependencies. Nothing framework specific is allowed to leak in here.
